decisions.reason: A formwork profile system with its own page is core to the firm's formwork offer for precast plants and fits its established business.
Automated concrete distributor flow control supports the firm's automation strategy and is a long-lifecycle equipment feature, though it is only mentioned on the website.
The shuttering magnet block is a standard consumable-type accessory that is cheap to keep in a modular product range, despite only being mentioned on the website.
Magnetic formwork strips have their own page and are a staple product in precast element production with steady demand.
This magnetic formwork component has its own page and complements the integrated formwork portfolio during a growth phase.
Though it is less prominently shown, this magnetic component costs little to keep within the modular range and could only be consolidated later.
